records.name: Evening return from Ta’ Qali — match times vs the last bus
records.hours: Community-wiki TWC schedule, converted to Malta time (CEST): Wed 14 Oct group matches at 10:30, 13:00, 15:30 and 18:00; 15–16 Oct times not yet listed; Sat 17 Oct semifinals at 16:00 and 19:00; Sun 18 Oct third-place match at 13:30 and grand final (best of five) at 17:00. Last listed Buġibba-bound Route 186 departure from Stadium 2194: 20:53.
records.price range: Bus €2.50 (summer rate) if you leave before the last bus; otherwise an app or taxi quote. No Ta’ Qali–Qawra fare was verified
records.description: Plan your ride back before evening sessions. The 18:00 match on 14 Oct, the 19:00 semifinal on 17 Oct and the 17:00 best-of-five final on 18 Oct start close to or after the last listed Route 186 return (20:53 from Stadium 2194). If you stay to the end of those sessions, plan on Bolt, eCabs, Uber or Malta Taxi. On Sat 17 Oct, MPT also lists a 19:00–midnight Route 186 detour that skips Gholja 2 through Targa toward Buġibba. Match lengths vary and the schedule can move, so recheck on the day.
records.notes: Match times are from Liquipedia, a community esports wiki (not the organizer); the official TWC page (https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/) gives only phase dates (groups 14–16 Oct, playoffs 17–18 Oct). Liquipedia also lists HLTV event 8932 for 14–18 Oct. Bus times are from https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/186/ (re-read 11 Oct 2026); the 17 Oct detour is from https://www.publictransport.com.mt/latest-service-updates/ . Ride-hailing and taxi operators are listed in their own records on this page.

Which of the fixtures on this page have Kalshi markets was not checked either.
records.notes: Checked 11 Oct 2026. The help article also lists debit card (Visa/Mastercard), wire transfer (minimum $1,000) and cryptocurrency as international deposit methods, depending on region. This guide does not recommend using a VPN or any other way around location checks.
